# GashoTech Create — AI Creative Studio
> URL: https://create.gashotech.com
> A unified platform for AI-powered chat, image generation, video generation, and image editing.

## Chat
https://create.gashotech.com/#chat
AI chat interface with multiple models: DeepSeek V4 Flash, Kimi K3, Qwen 3.8, Qwen 3.5, Qwen 3 Thinking, Gemma 4, GLM 5.2, Nemotron 3 Omni, Mistral Nemo. TEE-secured inference on all models. Persistent sessions, markdown rendering, code highlighting.

## Media Studio — Image Generation
https://create.gashotech.com/#media-image
Text-to-image and image-to-image generation. Models: FLUX, DreamShaper, Juggernaut, Illustrious XL. Credit-based pricing (1 credit per generation). Batch generation, history gallery.

## Media Studio — Video Generation
https://create.gashotech.com/#media-video
Text-to-video and image-to-video generation. Models: LTX 2.5 (distilled 8+3 step, up to 20s 1080p), WAN 2.1, LTX 2.3. Supports auto-duration, prompt enhancement, audio generation, keyframe interpolation, lip-sync (MuseTalk).

## Media Studio — Photoshop Corner
https://create.gashotech.com/#media-photoshop
Full browser-based image editor with layers, selections, brushes, filters, adjustments, text, shapes, gradients, clone stamp, effects (shadow/stroke/glow), groups, masks, rulers/guides, transform, and export presets (social/blog/print). Free to use (no credits for manual editing).

## Media Studio — Gallery
https://create.gashotech.com/#media-gallery
Saved generations, history, favorites. Download or re-edit past work.

## Pricing
https://create.gashotech.com/#pricing
Credit system: 1 credit per chat/image/video generation. Free tier includes signup credits. Additional credits available via purchase. Photoshop editing tools are free (no credit consumption).
